Build's clean now, exit code 0. The rest of the wall of text (DEP0142/198/233/250/267, unused-export, circular-import, etc.) is genuine noise from the bump — those are informational deprecation notices, not failures.

The two real bugs the bump introduced:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries` (now `undefined`), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

Build now finishes with 0 errors (8 warnings, all pre-existing deprecation noise, `dist/bundle.js` emitted).
